releases.body:
### Added
- V2 `raven_seek` and `raven_mcp` now run background child retrievals by default, with `background: false` for foreground waits.
- Compact completion/failure messages return to the actual calling session through V2's synthetic inbox. Undelivered results survive plugin reloads; unfinished retrievals report interruption instead of replaying MCP calls.
- Background lifecycle coverage for continuation locking, cancellation, session deletion, restart recovery, and delivery failures, plus an offline native V2 background smoke check.

### Fixed
- Automatic MCP refresh now runs once per workspace per TUI launch, rather than repeating on plugin reactivation or returning from sessions. Manual refresh remains available.

### Fixed
- V2 manual MCP refreshes now use notifications only, and reopening the TUI shows refresh progress and results in top-right notifications.
- V2 now refreshes on-demand MCP health and tool discovery whenever the TUI attaches to the background service, sharing overlapping checks instead of relying on one-time server initialization.
- V2 MCP-agent requests now receive live capability guidance so refreshed tools are visible without reloading the agent or service.
- V2 `/raven` output now uses an opaque, terminal-height-bounded dialog with keyboard and mouse scrolling instead of an overflowing alert.
- V2 public Raven delegation no longer asks for confirmation on every call. Deny rules and permissions for other tools remain unchanged.

### Added
- OpenCode 2 support through a native `setup()` adapter, sharing Raven configuration and MCP runtime with OpenCode 1.
- V2 agent/tool registration, shell routing, model discovery, guidance injection, child-session completion waiting, cancellation, continuation validation, and provider-error handling.
- A v2 terminal companion and typed RPC contract for immediate `/raven` command output and notifications without a model turn.
- Native-host smoke checks, including offline v2 routing and delegation, alongside v1/v2 regression tests.

### Changed
- Raised the OpenCode 1 minimum to 1.18.29 for the shared `server()`/`setup()` object entrypoint. The v2 adapter targets OpenCode 2.0.26 and newer 2.x releases.
- OpenCode 2 installation uses `plugins`; OpenCode 1 continues to use `plugin`.
- V2 update instructions delegate cache management to OpenCode instead of deleting v1 cache paths.

### Added
- Fresh installs automatically select an available zero-cost, tool-capable model from OpenCode's connected provider catalog for Raven Search and Raven MCP.
- `/raven seek model auto` and `/raven mcp model auto` retry free-model detection.

### Changed
- Removed the retired `opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free` default. Raven now leaves routing inactive and shows first-time setup instructions when no suitable free model is available.
- Auto-selected models are rechecked on startup, while manually configured models are never replaced.

### Fixed
- Plugin-created Raven sessions now emit a session update after creation so OpenCode adds root-level sessions to its navigable child-session list.
